description: Signal decay configuration. Controls how signal strength diminishes over time. Inspired by gtm-starter-kit decay logic.

regulatory-filing.notes: Annual filings remain relevant for the full reporting cycle. 10-K risk factors persist until next filing.

ai-investment.notes: AI investment announcements remain relevant for ~6 months as programs ramp up.

leadership-changes.notes: New leaders make decisions fast. 90-day window is when vendor evaluations happen.

hiring-patterns.notes: Job postings are perishable. After 30 days they're either filled or stale.

technology-shifts.notes: Platform migrations take months. Signal remains relevant through implementation.

competitive-movement.notes: Vendor evaluation windows are short. Act fast or the decision is made without you.

corporate-events.notes: M&A, IPO, funding create extended buying windows as integration/scaling occurs.

compliance-triggers.notes: Regulatory changes create long compliance tails. Enforcement actions have multi-year remediation.

community-intent.notes: Public posts and comments are perishable. Act inside the per-signal window; past 45 days use as language input only.

fresh.label: Fresh
fresh.notes: Signal detected in last 14 days. Maximum relevance. Prioritize outreach.

warm.label: Warm
warm.notes: Signal 14-60 days old. Still relevant. Standard outreach timing.

stale.label: Stale
stale.notes: Signal 60+ days old but not expired. Use as supporting context, not primary trigger.

expired.label: Expired
expired.notes: Signal past category decay_days. Drop from active scoring. Retain for historical analysis.

composite_score_formula.description: Overall signal score for an account = sum of (signal_strength_multiplier * age_score_multiplier * category_priority_weight)
